lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏌ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎤᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎢᎬᏱ ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏫᏓᏃᎸᎯ; ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᎣᏏᏳ ᏱᎩ, ᏗᏂᏲᎵ ᏧᎾᏤᎵ ᎦᏚ ᏗᎩᎡᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᎩᎵ ᏫᏓᏗᏁᏗᏱ.
lines.english: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

lines.english: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

lines.english: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
